summary: @onereach/billing-dto preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a TypeScript DTO library but ships a preinstall hook (`scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory and then invokes that freshly-downloaded runtime to execute `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript blob shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` uses a rotated hex-indexed string-array cipher (identifiers `n7gIxM`, `hc1jfK9`, `WV8StW` with a scrambled decode alphabet) that hides all string literals, control flow, and API calls, and `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0xXXXX` string-map obfuscation. Executing the payload under an alien runtime evades tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code, and the payload's actual behavior is not recoverable by static inspection. A DTO/type-definition package has no legitimate need for a downloaded alternate runtime or a heavily obfuscated install-time payload; the shape matches the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE pattern and fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
